a: Gemara amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben bava. veamar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo hutteru passe veraot ella liver mayim chayyim bilvad.
Utzericha: dei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yehuda ben bava, hava amena: derabbim — vaafillu mechunnasin,
Vehay dekatane beer harabbim — leappoke midderabbi akiva. ka mashma lan delo hutteru passe veraot ella liver mayim chayyim.
Vei ashmeinan beer mayim chayyim, hava amena: la shena derabbim vela shena deyachid, ka mashma lan: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben bava.

Mishna veod amar rabbi yehuda ben bava: hagginna vehakkarpef shehen shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim hammukkafot gader gavoah asara tefachim — metaltelin betochah, uvilvad sheyyehe bah shomera o bet dira, o shettehe semucha lair.

Rabbi yehuda omer: afillu en bah ella bor veshiach umeara metaltelin betochah. rabbi akiva omer: afillu en bah achat mikkol ellu metaltelin betochah, uvilvad sheyyehe bah shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim.
Rabbi eliezer omer: im hayta orkah yater al rochbah afillu amma achat — en metaltelin betochah. rabbi yose omer: afillu orkah pi shenayim berochbah — metaltelin betochah.
Amar rabbi ilay: shamati merabbi elazar, vaafillu hi kevet kor.
Vechen shamati mimmennu: anshe chatzer sheshshachach echad mehen velo erav — beto asur millehachnis ulehotzi lo, aval lahem muttar.
Vechen shamati mimmennu: sheyyotzin bearkabbalin bappesach. vechazarti al kol talmidav uvikkashti li chaver, velo matzati.
Gemara may tanna dekatane "veod".
Illema mishshum ditna leh chada lechumera vekatane achariti, mishshum hachi katane "veod" — veha rabbi yehuda ditna leh chada lechumera vekatane achariti, vela katane "veod"!
Hatam afseku rabbanan, hacha la afseku rabbanan.
Vechol hecha deafseku rabbanan la katane "veod"? veha rabbi eliezer desukka, deafseku rabbanan, vekatane "veod"?
Hatam, bemilleteh hu deafseku. hacha, bemilleta achariti afseku.
Rabbi akiva omer: afillu en bah echad mikkol ellu metaltelin betochah.
b: Rabbi akiva hayeynu tanna kamma!
Ikka benayyhu davar muat. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: davar muat yesh al shivim amma veshirayim, velo natnu chachamim bo shiur.
Vechamma shiur satayim? kachatzar hammishkan.
Mena hane mille?
Amar rav yehuda, deamar kera: "orech hechatzer mea vaamma verochav chamishshim bachamishshim". amra tora: tol chamishshim, vesabbev chamishshim.
Peshateh dikra bemay ketiv?! amar abbaye: haamed mishkan al sefat chamishshim, kede sheyyehe chamishshim amma lefanav veesrim amma lechol ruach varuach.
Rabbi eliezer omer: im hayta orkah kulei. vehatanya, rabbi eliezer omer: im hayta orkah yater al pi shenayim berochbah afillu amma achat — en metaltelin betochah!
Amar rav bivi bar abbaye: ki tenan name matnitin — [yater al] pi shenayim berochbah tenan. i hachi, hayeynu rabbi yose?!
Ikka benayyhu ribbua deribbeuha rabbanan.
Rabbi yose omer kulei. ittemar, amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose. verav bivi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi akiva.
Vetarvayyhu lekulla. utzericha, dei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yose, hava amena ad deikka shomera o bet dira. ka mashma lan halacha kerabbi akiva.
Vei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi akiva, hava amena daarich vekattin — la. ka mashma lan halacha kerabbi yose.
Karpef shehu yoter mibbet satayim shehukkaf ledira, nizra rubbo hare hu keginna, veasur.
Nata rubbo hare hu kechatzer, umuttar.
Nizra rubbo, amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: la amaran ella yoter mibbet satayim. aval bet satayim — muttar.
Keman? kerabbi shimon. ditnan, rabbi shimon omer: echad gaggot veechad chatzerot veechad karpefot reshut achat hen lechelim sheshshavtu betochan, velo lechelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit.
Lerabbi shimon name, kevan denizra rubbo — have hahu miuta

a: Betil leh legabbay rubba, vehave leh karpef yoter mibbet satayim — veasur.
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar: ha miuta — share. amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: la amaran ella dela have bet satayim, aval bet satayim — asur.
Keman? kerabbanan.
Verav yirmeya middifti matne lekulla: ha miuta — shere, amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: la amaran ella bet satayim, aval yoter mibbet satayim — asur. keman? kerabbi shimon.
Nata rubbo — hare hu kechatzer, umuttar. amar rav yehuda amar avimi: vehu sheasuyin itztabbelaot. verav nachman amar: af al pi sheen asuyin itztabbelaot.
Mar yehuda ikkela leve rav huna bar yehuda. chazanhu lehanhu dela avidi itztabbelaot, veka metalteli begavvayyhu. amar leh: la savar la mar leha daavimi? amar leh: ana kerav nachman sevira li.
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: karpef yoter mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira, ketzad hu ose? poretz bo pirtza yoter meeser, vegodro umaamido al eser, umuttar.
Ibbaya lehu: paratz amma vegadar amma [ufaratz amma ugedarah], ad shehishlimo leyoter meeser, mahu?
Amar leh, lav hayeynu ditnan: kol kele baale vattim, shiuran kerimmonim.
Uvae chizkiyya: nikkav kemotzi zayit usetamo, vechazar venikkav kemotzi zayit usetamo, ad shehishlimo lemotzi rimmon mahu?
Vaamar leh rabbi yochanan: rabbi, shanita lanu: sandal shennifseka achat meoznav vetikkenah — tame midras.
Nifseka sheniyya vetikkenah — tahor bah min hammidras, aval tame magga midras.
Vaamart ala: may shena rishona — deha kayyma sheniyya? sheniyya name — ha kayyma rishona?!
Vaamart lan ala: panim chadashot bau lechan. hacha name, panim chadashot bau lechan.
Kare aleh: let den bar inash. ikka deamri: kegon den bar nash.
Amar rav kahana: rechava sheachore habbattim — en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot.
Veamar rav nachman: im patach lo petach — muttar letaltel bechullo, petach mattiro. vela amaran ella sheppatach ulevassof hukkaf, aval hukkaf ulevassof patach — la.
Patach ulevassof hukkaf peshita! la tzericha, deit beh be dare. mahu detema: addata deve dare avdeh. ka mashma lan.
Karpef yoter mibbet satayim shehukkaf ledira venitmalle mayim, sevur rabbanan lememar kizraim damu — vaasir.
Amar lehu rav abba avu derav bereh derav mesharsheya: hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava: mayim kintaim damu, ushere.
b: Amar ammemar: vehu dechazyin letashmishta, aval la chazyin letashmishta — la.
Amar rav ashe: udechazyin letashmishta name la amaran ella sheen beomko yoter mibbet satayim, aval im yesh beomko yoter mibbet satayim — asur.
Velav milleta hi, midde dehave akkarya defere.
Hahi rechava dahavay befum nahara, dechad gisa hava petiach lemata, vechad gisa hava petiach lishvil shel keramim, ushevil shel keramim hava salek legudda denahara.
Amar abbaye: hechi naaved? laaved leh mechitza aggudda denahara — en osin mechitza al gabbe mechitza.
Velaaved leh tzurat happetach appumma dishvil shel keramim — atu gamle shadyayn leh.
Ella amar abbaye: lebed lechi appitcha dishvil shel keramim, demiggo demahneya lishvil shel keramim, mehanne name lirchava.
Amar leh rava: yomru lechi moil lishvil shel keramim dealma.
Ella amar rava: avdinan leh lechi lefitcha demata, demiggo demahne leh lechi lemata, mahne name lirchava.
Hilkach: taltole bemata gufa — shere. taltole birchava gufa — shere. mimmata lirchava umerchava lemata, peligi ba rav acha veravina: chad asar vechad share.

a: Man deshare — deha lekka dayorin. uman deasar — zimnin dehave ba dayorin veate letaltole.
Karpef yoter mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira uva lemaato, miato bailanot — la have miut.
Bana bo ammud gavoah asara verachav arbaa — have miut. pachot mishshelosha — la have miut. mishshelosha vead arbaa — rabba amar: have miut, verava amar: la have miut.
Rabba amar: have miut, deha nafek leh mittorat lavud. rava amar: la have miut, kevan dela have mekom arbaa — la chashiv.
Hirchik min hakkotel arbaa veasa mechitza — hoil. pachot mishshelosha — lo hoil. mishshelosha vead arbaa — rabba amar: hoil, rava amar: eno moil.
Rabba amar: hoil, deha nafek leh mittorat lavud. rava amar: eno moil, kevan dela have mekom arbaa, la chashiv.
Rav shimi matne lekulla: tach bo tit veyachol laamod bifne atzmo — have miut. eno yachol laamod bifne atzmo — rabba amar: have miut, rava amar: la have miut.
Rabba amar: have miut, hasheta miha kae. rava amar: la have miut, kevan dela yachol lemekam bifne atzmo, lo kelum hu.
Hirchik min hattel arbaa veasa mechitza — hoil.
Pachot mishshelosha o al sefat hattel, rav chisda verav hamenuna, chad amar: hoil, vechad amar: lo hoil.
Tistayyem derav chisda amar hoil, deittemar: haose mechitza al gabbe mechitza, amar rav chisda: beshabbat hoil.
Benichse hagger lo kana.
Verav sheshet amar: af beshabbat name lo hoil. tistayyem.
Amar rav chisda: umode li rav sheshet sheim asa mechitza al hattel — shehoil.
May tama, hoil uvaavir mechitzot haelyonot hu dar.
Bae rabba bar bar chana: nivleu mechitzot hattachtonot, vehaelyonot kayyaymot, mahu?
Lemay? i lenichse hagger, hayeynu deyirmeya biraa. deamar yirmeya biraa amar rav yehuda: hay man dishda lifta appila deara deger, vaata yisrael acharina refak bah pureta — batra kane, kamma la kane.
May tama? beiddana dishda — la ka shavach. ki ka shavcha — mimmela ka meshabbecha.
Veella leinyan shabbat, have mechitza hannaase beshabbat.
Vetanya: kol mechitza hannaase beshabbat, ben beshogeg ben bemezid — shemah mechitza.
Lav ittemar ala, amar rav nachman: lo shanu ella lizrok, aval letaltel — asur.
Ki ittemar derav nachman — ammezid ittemar.

Hahi itteta daavada mechitza al gabbe mechitza benichse hagger. ata hahu gavra, refak bah pureta. ata lekammeh derav nachman, okma bideh. ata[10] ihi veka tzavvcha kammeh. amar la: may ebed lach, dela machzekat kidmachzeki inashe.
Karpef bet shalosh vekera bo bet sea. rava amar: avir keruyo meyaytro. verabbi zera amar: en avir keruyo meyaytro.
Lema rava verabbi zera biflugeta derav ushemuel ka mippalgi. deittemar: achsadra bevika, rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullah, ushemuel amar: en metaltelin ella bearba ammot.
Rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullah — amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem. ushemuel amar: en metaltelin ella bearba ammot — la amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem.
b: I daavida ki achsadra hachi name. hacha bemay askinan, deavda ki urezila.
Amar rabbi zera: umodena bekarpef shennifratz bimloo lechatzer sheasur. may tama? hoil vaavir chatzer meyaytro.
Matkef la rav yosef: vechi avir hammuttar lo osro?
Amar leh abbaye: keman, kerabbi shimon? lerabbi shimon name, ha ikka avir mekom mechitzot.
Deamar rav chisda: karpef shennifratz bimloo lechatzer — chatzer mutteret vekarpef asur.
Chatzer may tama? deit leh gippufe? veha zimnin demashkachat la ippecha.
Ella, mishshum deamrinan: ze — avir mechitzot meyaytro, veze — en avir mechitzot meyaytro.
Hahu busetana dahava semich legudda deappadna. nefal ashita barayyta deappadna. savar rav bivi lememar lismoch aggudda gauoyata.
Amar leh rav pappi: mishshum deattu mimmulae amritu mille muleyayta. hanach mechitzot, legavvay — avidan, levaray — la avidan.
Hahi abbevoranka dahava leh leresh galuta bevusetaneh. amar leh lerav huna bar chinnana: lebed mar takkanta, delimchar nechul nahama hatam.
Azal avad kane kane pachot mishshelosha, azal rava

a: Shalfinhu. azal rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua, naktinhu mibbatreh.
Limchar etiveh ravina lerava: ir chadasha moddin lah miyyeshivatah, vishana mechomatah.
Ezo hi chadasha veezo hi yeshana? chadasha, shehukkefa ulevassof yashva. yeshana, yashva ulevassof hukkefa. vehay name kehukkefa ulevassof yashva dame!
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: vehaamar rav assi mechitzot adrechalin la shemah mechitza, alma kevan delitzniuta avida la — la havya mechitza. hacha name, kevan delitzniuta avida — la havya mechitza.
Veamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: vehaamar rav huna: mechitza haasuya lenachat — lo shemah mechitza!
Deha rabba bar avu mearev la lechulla machoza arseyayta arseyayta mishshum pera deve tore. veha pera deve tore kimchitza haasuya lenachat damya.
Kare alayyhu resh galuta: "chachamim hemma lehara ulehetiv lo yadau".
Amar rabbi ilay, shamati merabbi eliezer: vaafillu bet kor. matnitin dela kachananya. detanya, chananya omer: vaafillu hi arbaim sea keisteratya shel melech.

Amar rabbi yochanan: ushenehem mikra echad darshu, shenneemar: "vayhi yeshayahu lo yatza el chatzer hattichona". ketiv "hair" vekarenan "chatzer" — mikkan laisteratya shel melech shehayu kaayayrot benoniyyot.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: ayayrot benoniyyot havyayn bet kor. umar savar: arbaim sea havyayn.
Vishayahu may bae hatam? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: melammed shechala chizkiyya, vehalach yeshayahu vehoshiv yeshiva al pitcho.
Mikkan letalmid chacham shechala, shemmoshivin yeshiva al pitcho. velav milleta hi, dilma ate leiggaroye beh satan.
Vechen shamati hemennu: anshe chatzer sheshshachach echad velo erav — beto asur.
Vehatnan: beto asur lehotzi ulehachnis lo velahen?!
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar rav sheshet: la kashya,
b: Ha rabbi eliezer, veha rabbanan.
Keshettimtze lomar, ledivre rabbi eliezer: hamevattel reshut chatzero — reshut beto bittel. lerabbanan: hamevattel reshut chatzero — reshut beto lo bittel.
Peshita!
Amar rachava: ana verav huna bar chinnana targemna: lo nitzrecha ella lachamishsha sheshsheruyin bechatzer echad veshachach echad mehen velo erav.
Ledivre rabbi eliezer: keshehu mevattel reshuto, en tzarich levattel lechol echad veechad.
Lerabbanan: keshehu mevattel reshuto, tzarich levattel lechol echad veechad.
Keman azla ha detanya: chamishsha sheshsheruyin bechatzer echad veshachach echad mehen velo erav, keshehu mevattel reshuto, en tzarich levattel reshut lechol echad veechad. keman? kerabbi eliezer.

Rav kahana matne hachi. rav tavyome matne hachi: keman azla ha detanya: chamishsha sheshsheruyim bechatzer echad veshachach echad mehen velo erav, keshehu mevattel reshuto eno tzarich levattel reshut lechol echad veechad, keman? amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet: keman? kerabbi eliezer.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: lerabbi eliezer, i amar: la mevattelna, ulerabbanan, i amar: mevattelna — may?
Tama derabbi eliezer mishshum dekasavar: hamevattel reshut chatzero, reshut beto bittel. vehay amar: ana la mevattelna.
O dilma, tama derabbi eliezer mishshum devayit bela chatzer la avidi inashe dedayyri. vechi kaamar la mevattelna — lav kol keminneh, af al gav deamar dayayrna — lav kelum kaamar.
Ulerabbanan, i amar: mevattelna. may tama derabbanan? mishshum dekasavri: hamevattel reshut chatzero — reshut beto lo bittel, vehay amar mevattelna.
O dilma, tama derabbanan mishshum dela avid inish dimsallek nafsheh ligmare mibbayit vechatzer, vehave ki oreach legabbayyhu. vehay ki amar mevattelna — lav kol keminneh kaamar.
Amar leh: ben lerabbanan ben lerabbi eliezer, kevan degalli dateh — galli.
Vechen shamati mimmennu sheyyotzim bearkabbalin befesach. may arkabbalin? amar resh lakish: atzvota charuzeyata.
Hadaran alach osin passin
Mishna bakkol mearvin umishtattefin, chutz min hammayim umin hammelach.
Vehakkol nikkach bechesef maaser, chutz min hammayim umin hammelach. hannoder min hammazon — muttar bemelach uvemayim.
Mearvin lannazir beyayin uleyisrael bitruma. somchos omer: bechullin.
Velakkohen bevet happeras. rabbi yehuda omer: afillu ben hakkevarot.

a: Mippene sheyyachol lachotz, velelech veleechol.
Gemara amar rabbi yochanan: en lemedin min hakkelalot, vaafillu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz.
Middekaamar: afillu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz, mikkelal delav hacha kae, hecha kae?
Hatam kae kol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama, anashim chayyayvin venashim peturot. veshello hazzeman gerama, echad nashim veechad anashim chayyayvin.
Uchelala hu dechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot? hare matztza simcha vehakehel, demitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu, venashim chayyayvot.

Vechol mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama nashim chayyayvot? hare talmud tora, periyya ureviyya, ufidyon habben, demitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama venashim peturot. ella amar rabbi yochanan: en lemedin min hakkelalot vaafillu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz.

Amar abbaye, veittema rabbi yirmeya: af anan name tenena, od kelal acher amru: kol shennissa al gabbe hazzav — tame, vechol shehazzav nissa alav — tahor, chutz min harauy lemishkav umoshav, vehaadam. vetu lekka? veha ikka merkav?!

Merkav hechi dame? i deyatev aleh — hayeynu moshav. anan hachi kaamrinan: ha ikka gabba deukkafa, detanya: haukkaf — tame moshav, vehattefus — tame merkav. ella shema minna en lemedin min hakkelalot vaafillu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz.

Amar ravina, veittema rav nachman: af anan name tenena: bakkol mearvin umishtattefin, chutz min hammayim vehammelach. vetu lekka? veha ikka kemehin ufitriyyot?! — ella shema minna: en lemedin min hakkelalot vaafillu bimkom shenneemar bo chutz.
Hakkol nikkach bechesef maaser kulei. rabbi eliezer verabbi yose bar chanina, chad matne aeruv vechad matne ammaaser.
Chad matne aeruv: lo shanu ella mayim bifne atzmo umelach bifne atzmo deen mearvin. aval bemayim umelach — mearvin.
Vechad matne ammaaser: lo shanu ella mayim bifne atzmo umelach bifne atzmo, deen nikkachin. aval mayim umelach — nikkachin bechesef maaser.
Man dematne ammaaser, kol shekken aeruv. uman dematne aeruv, aval ammaaser la. may tama — pera bainan.

Ki ata rabbi yitzchak, matne ammaaser. metivi: heid rabbi yehuda ben gadish lifne rabbi eliezer: shel bet abba hayu lokchin tzir bechesef maaser. amar lo: shemma lo shamata ella keshekkirve dagim meoravin bahen. vaafillu rabbi yehuda ben gadish la kaamar ella betzir, deshumena defera hi, aval mayim umelach — lo.
Amar rav yosef:
b: Lo nitzrecha ella shennatan letochan shemen.
Amar leh abbaye: vetippok leh mishshum shemen! lo tzericha, shennatan deme mayim umelach behavelaa.

Uvehavlaa mi shere? in — vehatanya, ben bag bag omer: "babbakar" — melammed shellokchin bakar al gav oro. "uvatztzon" — melammed shellokchin tzon al gav gizzatah. "uvayyayin" — melammed shellokchin yayin al gav kankanno. "uvashshechar" — melammed shellokchin temed mishshehechmitz.
Amar rabbi yochanan: man dimtargem li "babbakar" allibba deven bag bag, movelna maneh abbatreh leve massuta.

May tama? kullehu tzerichi levar mibbabbakar", dela tzerich. may tzerichi? dei ketav rachamana "babbakar", hava amena: bakar hu demizdabban al gav oro, mishshum degufeh hu. aval tzon al gav gizzatah, delav gufeh hu — ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana "batztzon" al gav gizzatah, hava amena: mishshum dimchubbar bah. aval yayin al gav kankanno — ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana "bayyayin", hava amena: mishshum dehayynu netiruteh. aval temed mishshehechmitz dekiyyuha bealma hu, ema la. ketav rachamana "shechar".
Vei ketav rachamana "bashshechar", hava amena: may shechar? devela keilit, defera hu. aval yayin al gav kankanno — ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana yayin al gav kankanno — dehayynu netiruteh. aval tzon al gav gizzatah — ema la. ketav rachamana "tzon", daafillu al gav gizzatah.
"Babbakar" lema li?! vechi tema: i la ketav rachamana "babbakar", hava amena: tzon al gav orah in, al gav gizzatah la. ketav rachamana "babbakar" leetoye oro. iyyaytar leh "tzon" leetoye gizzatah.
I la ketav rachamana "bakar", la hava amena tzon al gav orah — in, al gav gizzatah — la. deim ken, lichtov rachamana "bakar", demimmela iyyaytar leh "tzon".

Vechevan dichtav rachamana "tzon", daafillu al gav gizzatah. "babbakar" lema li? hasheta tzon al gav gizzatah mizdabbena, bakar al gav oro mibbaya? hayeynu dekaamar rabbi yochanan: man dimtargem li "babbakar" allibba deven bag bag, movelna maneh leve massuta.
Bemay ka mippalgi rabbi yehuda ben gadish verabbi eliezer vehane tannae dilkamman? rabbi yehuda ben gadish verabbi eliezer darshi ribbuye umiute, vehane tannae darshi kelale uferate.

Rabbi yehuda ben gadish verabbi eliezer darshi ribbuye umiute. "venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha" — ribba, "babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar" — miet, "uvechol asher tisholcha nafshecha" — chazar veribba. ribba umiet veribba — ribba hakkol. may rabbi? rabbi kol mille. umay miet? lerabbi eliezer miet tzir, lerabbi yehuda ben gadish miet mayim umelach.

Vehane tannae darshi kelale uferate. detanya: "venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha" — kalal, "babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar" — parat, "uvechol asher tisholcha nafshecha" — chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal i atta dan ella keen happerat. uma happerat meforash: peri mipperi, vegiddule karka, af kol peri mipperi vegiddule karka.
Vetanya iddach: ma happerat meforash: velad valdot haaretz, af kol velad valdot haaretz.
May benayyhu? amar abbaye: dagim ikka benayyhu. leman deamar peri mipperi vegiddule karka, hane dagim — giddule karka ninhu. leman deamar velad valdot haaretz, dagim — mimmayya ibbero.
Umi amar abbaye dagim giddule karka ninhu? vehaamar abbaye:

a: Achal putita — loke arba. nemala — loke chamesh. tzira — loke shesh. veim ita — putita name lilke mishshum "hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz"!
Ella amar ravina: ofot ikka benayyhu. leman deamar peri mipperi vegiddule karka, hane name — giddule karka ninhu. leman deamar velad valdot haaretz, hane ofot — min harkak nivreu.
Man dimrabbe ofot — may tameh, uman dimmaet ofot — may tameh?
Man dimrabbe ofot, kasavar: kelala batra davka. perat uchelal — naase kelal musaf al happerat, veitrabbu lehu kol mille. veahni kelala kamma lemaote kol dela dame leh mishshene tzedadin.
Uman dimmaet ofot, kasavar: kelala kamma davvka, kelal uferat — veen bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat: hane — in, midde acharina — la. veahni kelala batra lerabboye kol dedame leh mishshelosha tzedadin.
Amar rav yehuda mishshemeh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: mearvin befapuin uvachalaglogot uvegudegdaniyyot, aval lo bachaziz velo bechafniyyot.
Uvegudegdaniyyot mi mearvin? vehatanya: gudegdaniyyot — merubbe vanim yochelu, chasuche vanim lo yochelu. veim hukeshu lezera — af merubbe banim lo yochelu!
Targema: ashshelo hukeshu lezera, umerubbe vanim.

Veibbaet ema: leolam lachasuche vanim, deha chazu limrubbe vanim. mi la tenan: mearvin lannazir beyayin uleyisrael bitruma. alma: af al gav dela chaze lehay — chaze lehay. hacha name, af al gav dela chaze lehay — chaze lehay.
Veibbaet ema: ki kaamar rav, behanedkoke madae.
Uvachaziz la? vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: keshut vachaziz mearvin bahen, umevarchin alehen "bore peri haadama"!
La kashya: ha — mikkamme daata rav levavel, ha — levatar daata rav levavel.

Uvavel havya rubba dealma? vehatanya: happol vehasseora vehattiltan shezzeraan leyarak — batla dato etzel kol adam. lefichach: zaran chayyayv, veyarkan patur. hashshachalayim vehaggargir shezzeraan leyarak — mitasserin yarak vezera, zeraan lezera — mitasserin zera veyarak.
Ki kaamar rav,
b: Bidginnuneyayta.
Zera gargir. lemay chaze? amar rabbi yochanan: shekken rishonim shello haya lahen pilpelin, shochakin oto umatbilin bo et hatztzali.
Rabbi zera ki hava chalish miggirseh, hava azel veyatev appitcha derav yehuda bar amme, amar: ki nafki veayyli rabbanan — ekum mikkammayyhu vaakabbel behu agra.

Nefak ata yanoka deve rav, amar leh: may agmerach rabbach? amar leh: keshut "bore peri haadama", chaziz "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". amar leh: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera, hay — meara ka mirabbe, vehay — meavvera ka mirabbe.

Vehilcheta keyanoka deve rav. may tama: hay — gemar pere, vehay — lav gemar pere. umay dekaamrat: hay meara ka rave, vehay meavvera ka rave — la hi. keshut name meara ka rave, deha ka chazenan dekatlinan la lehizmeta umayyta keshuta.
Uvechafniyyot en mearvin? vehatanya: kor nikkach bechesef maaser, veen mittamme tumeat ochalin. vechafniyyot nikkachot bechesef maaser, umittammeot tumeat ochalim.
Rave yehuda omer: kor hare hu keetz lechol devarav — ella shennikkach bechesef maaser, vechafniyyot hare hen kifri lechol divrehem — ella sheppeturot min hammaaser.
Hatam, bidnischane.
I hachi, beha lema rabbi yehuda peturot min hammaaser? vehatanya, amar rabbi yehuda: lo huzekru pagge vetyone ella leinyan maaser bilvad. pagge vetyone vaahine detovina chayyayvin bemaaser.
Ella leolam lav benischane, uleinyan tumeat ochalin shane, kidamar rabbi yochanan: hoil verauy lemattekan al yede haur, hacha name: hoil veyachol lemattekan al yede haur.

Vehecha ittemar derabbi yochanan? aha detanya: shekedim hammarim — ketannim chayyayvin, gedolim peturin. metukim — gedolim chayyayvin, ketannim peturin. rabbi shimon berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv: ze vaze, liftur. veamri la: ze vaze lechiyyuv. amar rabbi ila: hora rabbi chanina betzippori kedivre haomer ze veze liftur.
Uleman deamar ze vaze lechiyyuv, lemay chaze? amar rabbi yochanan: hoil verauy lemattekan al yede haur.
Amar mar, rabbi yehuda omer: kor hare hu keetz lechol devarav, ella shennikkach bechesef maaser. hayeynu tanna kamma!
Amar abbaye: shelako vetiggeno ikka benayyhu.
Matkef la rava: mi ikka leman deamar shelako vetiggeno la? vehatanya: haor vehashshilya en mittammein tumeat ochalin. or sheshshelako, veshilya shechishshev aleha — mittammein tumeat ochalin!
Ella amar rava: ikka benayyhu beracha. deittemar: kor — rav yehuda amar: "bore peri haadama", ushemuel amar: "shehakkol nihye bidvaro".
Rav yehuda amar: "bore peri haadama" — uchela hu. ushemuel amar: "shehakkol nihye bidvaro" — kevan shessofo lehakeshot, la mevarchinan illaveh "bore peri haadama".
Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, kevotaych mistabbera, deha tzenon shessofo lehakeshot, umevarchinan aleh "bore peri haadama".
Vela hi, tzenon nati inashe addata defugela, dikla — la nati inashe addata dekora. veaf al gav dekalleseh shemuel lerav yehuda, hilcheta kevoteh dishmuel.
Gufa, amar rav yehuda amar rav: keshut vachaziz mearvin bahen, umevarchin alehem "bore peri haadama". keshut bechamma? kidamar rav yechiel: kimlo hayyad — hacha name kimlo hayyad.
Chaziz bechamma? amar rabba bar toviyya bar yitzchak amar rav: kimlo uzilta deikkare.
Amar rav chilkiyya bar toviyya: mearvin bekilya. bekilya salka datach?! ella beyarka dekilya, vechamma? amar rav yechiel: kimlo hayyad.

Rabbi yirmeya nefak lekiryayta, beo minneh: mahu learev befolin lachin? la hava bideh. ki ata leve midresha, amaru leh: hachi amar rabbi yannay: mearvin befolin lachin. vechamma? amar rav yechiel: kimlo hayyad.
Amar rav hamenuna: mearvin bitradin chayyin. ini? vehaamar rav chisda: silka chayyay katel gavra chayyay!

a: Hahu, bivshil vela beshil.
Ikka deamri, amar rav hamenuna: en mearvin bitradin chayyin, deamar rav chisda: silka chayyay katel gavra chayyay. veha ka chazenan deka achli vela mayyti? hatam bivshil vela beshil.
Amar rav chisda: tavshil shel teradin yafe lallev vetov laenayim, vechol shekken livne meayim. amar abbaye: vehu deyatev abbe tafe veaved toch toch.
Amar rava: hareni keven azzay beshuke teverya. amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava: tappuchim bechamma? amar leh: vechi mearvin betappuchim?
Vela? vehatnan: kol haochalin mitztarfin lifsol et haggevivyya bachatzi feras, uvimzon shete seudot leeruv, uchevetza letamme tumeat ochalim!
Vehay may teyuveta? illema mishshum dekatane "kol haochalin", vehane bene achila ninhu — vehaamar rabbi yochanan: en lemedin min hakkelalot vaafillu bimkom shenneemar bo "chutz"!
Ella mishshum dekatane "uvimzon shete seudot leeruv uchevetza letamme tumeat ochalin". vehane name bene tammoye tumeat ochalin ninhu.
Vechamma? amar rav nachman: tappuchim bekav.

Metivi, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: uchela tavlin, velitra yarak, vaasara egozin, vachamishsha afarsekin, ushene rimmonim, veetrog echad. veamar guresak bar dare mishshemeh derav menashsheya bar seguveli mishshemeh derav, vechen leeruv. vehane name lihvo ki afarsekin!
Hane chashivi, vehane la chashivi.

Amar rav yosef: shera leh mareh lerav menashsheya bar seguveli, ana amrita nihaleh ammatnitin, vehu amra abbarayyta. ditnan: en pochatin leani baggoren mechatzi kav chittin vekav seorin. rabbi meir omer: chatzi kav seorin. vekav vachatzi chussemin, vekav gerogrot o mane devela. rabbi akiva omer: peras. vachatzi log yayin, rabbi akiva omer: reviit. ureviit shemen, rabbi akiva omer: sheminit. ushear kol happerot, amar abba shaul: kede sheyyimkerem veyikkach bahen mezon shete seudot. veamar rav: vechen leeruv.
Umay ulemeh dehay mehach? illema mishshum deka tane behach tavlin, vetavlin lav bene achila ninhu — attu hacha mi la katane chittin useorin, velav bene achila ninhu!
Ella mishshum dekatane chatzi log yayin, veamar rav: mearvin bishte reviiyyot shel yayin. middevainan kulle hay — shema minna ki amar rav "vechen leeruv" — aha matnitin kaamar. shema minna.
Amar mar: uvimzon shete seudot leeruv. savar rav yosef lememar: ad deikka seuda mehay useuda mehay. amar leh rabba: afillu lemechetza lishlish velirvia.

Gufa, amar rav: mearvin bishte reviiyyot shel yayin. umi bainan kulle hay? vehatanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: yayin kede leechol bo, chometz kede letabbel bo, zetim uvetzalim kede leechol bahen shete seudot?
Hatam bechamra mevashshela.
Amar mar: chometz kede letabbel bo. amar rav giddel amar rav: kede letabbel bo mezon shete seudot shel yarak. ikka deamri, amar rav giddel amar rav: yarak hanneechol bishte seudot.

Amar mar: zetim uvetzalim kede leechol bahen mezon shete seudot. uvivtzalim mi mearvin? vehatanya: amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: paam achat shavat rabbi meir beardiska, uva adam echad lefanav, amar lo: rabbi, eravti bivtzalim letivin, vehoshivo rabbi meir bearba ammot shello.
La kashya: ha bealim, ha beimmahot. detanya: achal batzal vehishkim umet, en omrin mimma met. veamar shemuel: lo shanu ella bealim, aval beimmahot — let lan ba. uvealin name la amaran ella
b: Dela ibbetzil zirta, aval ibbetzil zirta — let lan ba.
Amar rav pappa: la amaran ella dela ishti shichra, aval ishti shichra let lan ba.

Tanu rabbanan: lo yochal adam batzal, mippene nachash shebbo. umaase berabbi chanina sheachal chatzi vatzal vachatzi nachash shebbo vechala venata lamut, uvikkeshu chaverav rachamim alav vechaya, mippene shehashshaa tzericha lo.

Amar rabbi zera amar shemuel: shechar mearvin bo, ufosel et hammikve bishloshet luggin. matkef la rav kahana: peshita, vechi ma ben ze leme tzeva? ditnan: rabbi yose omer: me tzeva poslin et hammikve bishloshet luggin. amri: hatam mayya detziva mikkere, hacha shichra ikkeri.

Uvechamma mearvin? savar rav acha bereh derav yosef kammeh derav yosef lememar: bitren rive shichra, keditnan: hammotzi yayin, kede mezigat hakkos. vetane ala: kede mezigat kos yafe. may kos yafe? kos shel beracha. veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: kos shel beracha tzarich sheyyehe bo rova reviit, kede sheyyimzegennu veyaamod al reviit. vechidrava, deamar rava: kol chamra dela dare al chad telat mayya — lav chamra hu.
Vekatane sefa: ushear kol hammashkin birviit, vechol hashshofchin birviit. middehatam al chad arba — hacha name al chad arba.
Vela hi, hatam hu divtzir mehachi la chashiv, aval hacha — la. daavidi inashe deshatu kasa betzafra vechasa befanya, vesamchi illavayhu.
Temarim bechamma? amar rav yosef: temarim bekav. amar rav yosef: mena amena la? detanya: achal gerogrot veshillem temarim — tavo alav beracha.

Hechi dame? illema lefi damim, daachal minneh bezuza veka meshallem leh bezuza — may "tavo alav beracha"? bezuza achal, bezuza ka meshallem! ella lav, lefi midda, daachal minneh geriva digrogrot deshavya zuza, veka meshallem leh geriva ditmarim deshave arbea — vekatane: "tavo alav beracha", alma: temarim adifi.
Amar leh abbaye: leolam daachal minneh bezuza, veka meshallem bezuza. umay "tavo alav beracha"? daachal minneh midde dela kafetz aleh zavena, veka meshallem leh midde dekafetz aleh zavena.
Shetita — amar rav acha bar pinchas: tere shargushe. kisane — amar abbaye: tere vune defumebdita.
Amar abbaye, amara li em: hane kisane meallu lelibba, umevatteli machshevata.

Veamar abbaye, amara li em: hay man deit leh chulesha delibba, layyte bisra deatma yammina dedichra, velayyte kabbuye dereita denisan, vei lekka kabbuye dereita — layyte sugeyayne daaravta, venichabbeveh venechul, venishte batreh chamra marka.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol shehu liftan, kede leechol bo. kol sheeno liftan, kede leechol hemennu. basar chay — kede leechol hemennu. basar tzali, rabba amar: kede leechol bo, verav yosef amar: kede leechol hemennu.
Amar rav yosef: mena amena la — dehane parsae achli tavhaki bela nahama! amar leh abbaye: ufarsae havo rubba dealma?! vehatnan: bigde aniyyim laaniyyim, bigde ashirim laashirim.

a: Aval bigde ashirim laaniyyim — la.
Vechi tema: hacha lechumera vehacha lechumera, vehatanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: mearvin lechole ulezaken kede mezono. uleraavtan, bisuda benonit shel kol adam. kashya.
Umi amar rabbi shimon ben elazar hachi? vehatanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: og melech habbashan — pitcho kimloo!
Veabbaye: hatam hechi lebed, haddome nehaddemeh [venappekeh]?!
Ibbaya lehu: peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi shimon ben elazar, o la? ta shema, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: og melech habbashan pitcho bearbaa.
Hatam deikka petachim ketannim tuva, veikka chad dehave arbaa, devadday ki ka meravvach — behahu ka meravvach.
Amar rav chiyyay bar rav ashe amar rav: mearvin bevasar chay. amar rav shimi bar chiyyay: mearvin bevetzim chayyot. vechamma? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: achat. sinay amar: shetayim.

Hannoder min hammazon, muttar bammayim kulei. melach umayim hu dela ikkeri mazon, ha kol mille ikkeri mazon. lema tehve teyuveta derav ushemuel. derav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: en mevarchin "bore mine mezonot" ella al chameshet hamminin bilvad.
Vela otvinneh chada zimna? lema tehve teyuvetayyhu name meha!
Amar rav huna: beomer "kol hazzan alay". mayim umelach hu dela zayyni, ha kol mille zayyni.

Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana: ki hava azelna batreh derabbi yochanan lemechal pere deginnosar, ki havenan be mea — hava menakketinan lechol chad vechad asra asra. ki havenan be asra — hava menakketinan lechol chad vechad mea mea. vechol mea minnayyhu (la) have machazik lehu tzanna bat telata save, vahava achel lehu lechullehon, veamar: shevuata dela teim li ziyyuna! ema: "mezona".
Amar rav huna amar rav: "shevua shello ochal kikkar zo" — mearvin lo bah. "kikkar zo alay" — en mearvin lo bah.
Metivi: hannoder min hakkikkar — mearvin lo bah. may lav, deamar "alay"? la, deamar "zo".
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: ematay, bizman sheamar "shevua shello etamenna".

Aval amar "alay", may? hachi name deen mearvin lo bah? i hachi, addetane "kikkar zo hekdesh" en mearvin lo bah, lefi sheen mearvin bahekdeshot — liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim, deamar "zo", aval amar "alay" — en mearvin lo bah!
Amar lecha rav huna: ella may, kol hecha deamar "alay" mearvin? kashya resha?
Chassore michassera, vehachi katane: hannoder min hakkikkar mearvin lo bah, vaafillu amar "alay" — naasa keomer: shevua shello etamenna.
Mikkol makom kashya lerav huna! hu deamar kerabbi eliezer. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: "shevua shello ochal kikkar zo" — mearvin lo bah. "kikkar zo alay" — en mearvin lo bah.

Umi amar rabbi eliezer hachi? vehatanya, ze hakkelal: adam oser atzmo beochel — mearvin lo bah. ochel hannesar lo leadam — en mearvin lo bah. rabbi eliezer omer: "kikkar zo alay" — mearvin lo bah. "kikkar zo hekdesh" — en mearvin lo bah, lefi sheen mearvin lo bahekdeshot!
Tere tannae veallibba derabbi eliezer.

Mearvin lannazir beyayin kulei. matnitin dela kevet shammay. detanya, bet shammay omrim: en mearvin lannazir beyayin uleyisrael bitruma, bet hillel omrim: mearvin lannazir beyayin uleyisrael bitruma. amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay: i attem modim
b: Shemmearvin legadol beyom hakkippurim!
Amru lahen: aval! amru lahen: keshem shemmearvin laggadol beyom hakkippurim, ken mearvin lannazir beyayin uleyisrael bitruma.
Uvet shammay: hatam — ikka seuda haruya mibbeod yom, hacha — lekka seuda haruya mibbeod yom.
Keman? dela kachananya. detanya, chananya omer: kol atzman shel bet shammay lo hayu modim beeruv ad sheyyotzi mittato vechol kele tashmishav lesham.
Keman azla ha detanya: erav bishchorim lo yetze bilvanim, bilvanim lo yetze bishchorim. keman? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: chananya hi, veallibba devet shammay.

Velachananya, bishchorim hu delo yetze, ha bilvanim yetze? haamar ad sheyyotzi mittato uchele tashmishav lesham! hachi kaamar: erav bilvanim vehutzerach lishchorim, af bilvanim lo yetze. keman? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: chananya hi, veallibba devet shammay.
Somchos omer bechullin. veillu lannazir beyayin la pelig, may tama — efshar demitteshil anneziruteh.
I hachi, teruma name efshar demitteshil illavay? i mitteshil ala — hadra letivla.
Velayfrosh ala mimmakom acher? la nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf.
Velafrosh ala minneh uveh! delet ba shiura.
Umay paska? ella, somchos savar la kerabbanan deamri: kol davar shehu mishshum shevut gazru alav ben hashshemashot.

Keman azla ha ditnan: yesh sheamru hakkol lefi ma shehu adam. melo kumetzo mincha, umelo chofnav ketoret, vehashshote melo lugemav beyom hakkippurim, uvimzon shete seudot leeruv. keman? amar rabbi zera: somchos hi, deamar: may dachaze leh bainan.
Lema peliga adderabbi shimon ben elazar, detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: mearvin lechole ulezaken kede mezono, uleraavtan bisuda benonit shel kol adam!
Targuma, achole vezaken. aval raavtan, batla dato etzel kol adam.
Velakkohen bevet happeras. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: menappeach adam bet happeras veholech. rabbi yehuda bar amme mishshemeh derav yehuda amar: bet happeras shenniddash — tahor.
Rabbi yehuda omer: af bet hakkevarot. tana: mippene sheyyachol lachotz velelech beshidda teva umigdal. ka savar: ohel zaruk shemeh ohel.
Uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: hannichnas leeretz haammim beshidda teva umigdal — rabbi metamme, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda metaher.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar ohel zaruk lav shemeh ohel, umar savar ohel zaruk shemeh ohel.
Veha detanya, rabbi yehuda omer:

a: Mearvin lechohen tahor bitruma tehora bekever, hechi azel? beshidda teva umigdal.
Veha kevan deachata ittammeya la! beshello hucheshra, o shennillosha beme perot.
Vehechi mayyte la? bifshute chele etz dela mekabbeli tumea.
Veha ka maahil?! demayyte la achoreh.
I hachi, may tama derabbanan? kasavri: asur liknot bayit beissure hanaa.
Mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar muttar? kasavar: mitzvot lav lehanot nittenu.

Ella ha deamar rava: mitzvot lav lehanot nittenu, lema ketannae amra lishmateh?! amar lach rava: i sevira lehu deen mearvin ella lidvar mitzva — dechulle alma mitzvot lav lehanot nittenu. vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar en mearvin ella lidvar mitzva, umar savar mearvin afillu lidvar harshut.
Ella ha deamar rav yosef: en mearvin ella lidvar mitzva, lema ketannae amra lishmateh?

Amar lecha rav yosef: dechulle alma en mearvin ella lidvar mitzva, udechulle alma mitzvot lav lehanot nittenu, uveha kamippalgi: mar savar kevan dikna leh eruv — la nicha leh deminnatra. umar savar — nicha leh deminnatra, dei itzterich achel leh.
Mishna mearvin bidmay, uvemaaser rishon shennittela terumato, uvemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, vehakkohanim bechalla.
Aval lo betevel, velo bemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, velo bemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu.
Gemara demay, ha la chaze leh? miggo dei bae mafkar lehu lenichseh vehave ani vachazu leh — hasheta name chaze leh. ditnan: maachilin et haaniyyim demay
b: Veet achsanya demay.
Amar rav huna: tana, bet shammay omrim: en maachilin et haaniyyim demay, uvet hillel omrim: maachilin et haaniyyim demay.
Uvemaaser rishon shennittela kulei. peshita! la tzericha, shehikdimo beshibbolin, venittela mimmennu terumat maaser, velo nittela mimmennu teruma gedola.

Vechidrabbi avahu amar resh lakish, deamar rabbi avahu amar resh lakish: maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibbolin — patur mitteruma gedola, shenneemar: "vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai maaser min hammaaser". maaser min hammaaser amarti lecha, velo teruma gedola uterumat maaser min hammaaser.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: i hachi, afillu hikdimo bichri name! amar leh: alecha amar kera: "mikkol maserotechem tarimu et kol terumat Adonai".
Uma raita? hay — iddegan, vehay — la iddegan.
Uvemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu. peshita! la tzericha, shennatan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh. veka mashma lan deen hachomesh meakkev.
Aval lo betevel. peshita! la tzericha, betevel tavul midderabbanan, uchegon shezzerao beatzitz sheeno nakuv.
Velo bemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato. peshita! la tzericha, shehikdimo bichri, venittela mimmennu terumat maaser velo nittela mimmennu teruma gedola.
Mahu detema kedaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye. ka mashma lan kidshanni leh.
Velo bemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. peshita!
La tzericha, sheppedaan, velo pedaan kehilchatan: maaser — sheppedao al gav asimon, verachamana amar: "vetzarta hakkesef" — kesef sheyyesh alav tzura.
Hekdesh — shechillelo al gav karka, derachamana amar: "venatan hakkesef vekam lo".
Mishna hashsholeach eruvo beyad cheresh shote vekatan, o beyad mi sheeno mode beeruv — eno eruv. veim amar leacher lekabbelo mimmennu — hare ze eruv.
Gemara vekatan la? vehaamar rav huna: katan gove et haeruv! la kashya: kan beeruve techumin, kan beeruve chatzerot.
O beyad mi sheeno mode beeruv. man? amar rav chisda: kutae.
Veim amar leacher lekabbelo hemennu, hare ze eruv. velechush dilma la mamte leh? kidamar rav chisda beomed veroehu, hacha name — beomed veroehu.
Velechush dilma la shakel minneh? kidamar rav yechiel: chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto, hacha name — chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto.

Vehecha ittemar derav chisda verav yechiel? aha ittemar, detanya: netano lappil veholicho, lakkof veholicho, en ze eruv. veim amar leacher lekabbelo hemennu — hare ze eruv. vedilma la mamte leh? amar rav chisda beomed veroehu. vedilma la mekabbel leh minneh? amar rav yechiel: chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto.
Amar rav nachman: beshel tora — en chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto.

a: Beshel sofrim — chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto. verav sheshet amar: echad ze veechad ze — chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto.
Amar rav sheshet: mena amena la, ditnan: mishshekkarav haomer, huttar hechadash miyyad.
Veharchokim muttarim mechatzot hayyom veelach. veha chadash deorayyta hu, vekatane: harchokim muttarin mechatzot hayyom veelach. lav mishshum chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto?
Verav nachman? hatam kidkatane tama — lefi sheyyodin sheen bet din mitatztzelin bo.
Veikka deamri, amar rav nachman: mena amena la, dekatane tama lefi sheyyodin sheen bet din mitatztzelin bo. bet din hu dela mitatztzelin bo — ha sheliach mitatztzel bo!
Verav sheshet amar lach: bet din ad palgeh deyoma, shaliach kulle yoma.

Amar rav sheshet: mena amena la, detanya: haishsha sheyyesh aleha leda o ziva, mevia maot venotenet bashshofar, vetovelet veochelet bakkodashim laerev. may tama — lav mishshum deamrinan chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto.
Verav nachman? hatam kidrav shemaya, deamar rav shemaya: chazaka en bet din shel kohanim omdim mishsham ad sheyyichlu kol maot shebbashshofar.

Amar rav sheshet: mena amena la, detanya: haomer lachavero "tze velakket lecha teenim mitteenati" — ochel mehen aray umeasseran vadday. "malle lecha kalkalla zo teenim mitteenati" — ochel mehen aray umeasseran demay.

Bamme devarim amurim — beam haaretz, aval bechaver — ochel veeno tzarich leasser, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bamme devarim amurim — beam haaretz, aval bechaver — eno ochel ad sheyyeasser, lefi shello nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf.
Amar rabbi: nirin devaray middivre abba. mutav sheyyechashdu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf, velo yaachilu leamme haaretz tevalim.
Ad kan la peligi ella demar savar: nechshedu, umar savar: lo nechshedu. aval kulle alma: chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto.
Verav nachman, hatam kidrav chanina chozaa, deamar rav chanina chozaa: chazaka hu al chaver sheeno motzi davar sheeno metukkan mittachat yado.
Amar mar: bamme devarim amurim — beam haaretz, aval bechaver — ochel veeno tzarich leasser, divre rabbi.

Hay am haaretz, dekaamar leh leman? ilema dekaamar leam haaretz chavreh — measseran demay, mi tzayet? ella beam haaretz dekaamar leh lechaver. ema sefa: nirin devaray middivre abba, mutav sheyyechashdu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf veal yaachilu leamme haaretz tevalin. amme haaretz may bae hatam?
Amar ravina: resha — beam haaretz sheamar lechaver, sefa — bechaver sheamar leam haaretz, vechaver acher shomo. rabbi
b: Savar: oto chaver ochel veeno tzarich leasser, devadday ayssore meassar hahu chaver kamma illaveh. verabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo yochal ad sheyyeasser, lefi shello nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf. vaamar leh rabbi: mutav sheyyechashdu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf veal yaachilu amme haaretz tevalim.

Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi savar: nicha leh lechaver deleeved hu issura kallila vela leeved am haaretz issura rabba. verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: nicha leh lechaver deleeved am haaretz issura rabba, veihu afillu issura kallila la leeved.
Mishna netano beilan, lemala measara tefachim — en eruvo eruv, lematta measara tefachim — eruvo eruv. netano bevor, afillu amok mea amma — eruvo eruv.

Gemara yatev rabbi chiyyay bar abba verabbi assi verava bar natan, veyatev rav nachman gabbayyhu, veyatvi vekaamri: hay ilan, dekae hecha? illema dekae birshut hayyachid, ma li lemala ma li lematta? reshut hayyachid ola ad larakia.
Veella dekae birshut harabbim. demitkavven lishbot hecha? illema denitkavvevn lishbot lemala — hu veeruvo bimkom echad hu. ella nitkavvevn lishbot lematta — veha ka mishtammesh beilan!
Leolam dekae birshut harabbim, venitkavvevn lishbot lematta. verabbi hi, deamar: kol davar shehu mishshum shevut lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot.

Amar lehu rav nachman: yishar, vechen amar shemuel. amaru leh: patritu bah kulle hay?! inhu name hachi ka patri bah! [ella hachi] amaru leh: kavitu leh bigmara? amar lehu: in. ittemar name, amar rav nachman amar shemuel: hacha bailan haomed birshut harabbim askinan, gavoah asara verachav arbaa, venitkavvevn lishbot lematta, verabbi hi, deamar: kol davar shehu mishshum shevut lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot.
Amar rava: lo shanu ella beilan haomed chutz leibburah shel ir, aval ilan haomed betoch ibburah shel ir — afillu lemala measara hare ze eruv, demata keman demalya damya.
I hachi, chutz leibburah shel ir name, kevan deamar rava: hannoten eruvo yesh lo arba ammot, havya la reshut hayyachid — ureshut hayyachid ola ad larakia!
Amar rav yitzchak bereh derav mesharsheya: hacha bailan hannote chutz learba ammot askinan,

a: Venitkavven lishbot beikkaro. umay "lemala" umay "lematta" — dahadar zakef.
Veha i bae mayyte la derech alav!
Kesherabbim mechattefin alav, vechidulla. deamar ulla: ammud tisha birshut harabbim, verabbim mechattefin alav, vezarak venach al gabbav — chayyayv.
May rabbi, umay rabbanan?

Detanya: netano beilan, lemala measara tefachim — en eruvo eruv, lematta measara tefachim — eruvo eruv, veasur littelo. betoch shelosha — muttar littelo. netano bechalkalla utelao beilan, afillu lemala measara tefachim — eruvo eruv, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: kol makom sheasur littelo — en eruvo eruv.
Vachachamim omrim aheyay? illema assefa — lema kasavri rabbanan, tzedadin asurin?! ella aresha.
Hay ilan hechi dame? i delet beh arbaa — mekom petur hu. vei deit beh arbaa, ki netano bechalkalla may have?
Amar ravina: resha deit beh arbaa, sefa delet beh arbaa vechalkalla mashlimato learbaa.
b: Verabbi savar la kerabbi meir, vesavar la kerabbi yehuda.
Savar la kerabbi meir, deamar chokkin lehashelim.
Vesavar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar bainan eruv al gabbe mekom arbaa, velekka.
May rabbi yehuda? detanya: rabbi yehuda omer: naatz kora birshut harabbim vehinniach eruvo aleha, gavoah asara urechava arbaa — eruvo eruv, veim lav — en eruvo eruv.
Adderabba, hu veeruvo bimkom echad! ella hachi kaamar: gavoah asara — tzarich sheyyehe beroshah arbaa, en gevoha asara — en tzarich sheyyehe beroshah arbaa.
Keman? dela kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda, detanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: naatz kane birshut harabbim vehinniach berosho teraskal, vezarak venach al gabbav — chayyayv!
Afillu tema rabbi yose berabbi yehuda, hatam — hadran mechitzata. hacha — la hadran mechitzata.
Rabbi yirmeya amar: shane kalkalla, hoil veyachol lintotah velahaviah letoch asara.
Yatev rav pappa veka amar leha shemata. etiveh rav bar shabba lerav pappa: ketzad hu ose? molicho barishon umachshich alav, venotlo uva lo. bashsheni, machshich alav veochlo, uva lo.

a: Ammay? nema: kevan dei bae amtoye matze mamte leh, af al gav dela amteyeh — keman deamteyeh dame!
Amar rabbi zera: gezera mishshum yom tov shechal lihyot achar shabbat.

Etiveh: nitkavvevn lishbot birshut harabbim, vehinniach eruvo bakkotel, lematta measara tefachim — eruvo eruv, lemala measara tefachim — en eruvo eruv. nitkavvevn lishbot berosh hashshovach o berosh hammigdal, lemala measara tefachim — eruvo eruv. lematta measara tefachim — en eruvo eruv.
Veammay? hachi name nema: hoil veyachol lintoto velahavio letoch asara! amar rabbi yirmeya: hacha bemigdal mesummar askinan.
Rava amar: afillu tema bemigdal sheeno mesummar, vehacha bemigdal aroch askinan, dei mamte leh pureta, azel chutz learba ammot.
Hechi dame? i deikka kavvevta umitna — layyteh bechavvevta umitna! delet leh kavvevta umitna.
Netano bevor afillu amok mea amma vechulei. hay bor dekae hecha? illema dekae birshut hayyachid —
b: Peshita! reshut hayyachid ola ad larakia, vechi hechi desalka leel, hachi name denachata letachat. veella dekae birshut harabbim.
Denitkavvevn lishbot hecha? i lemala — hu bemakom echad veeruvo bemakom acher hu. i lematta, peshita — hu veeruvo bimkom echad!
La tzericha, dekae becharmelit venitkavvevn lishbot lemala, verabbi hi deamar: kol davar shehu mishshum shevut lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot.
Mishna netano berosh hakkane o berosh hakkunedas, bizman shehu talush venautz, afillu gavoah mea amma — hare ze eruv.

Gemara rame leh rav adda bar matna lerava: talush venautz — in. lo talush venautz — la. manni? rabbanan hi, deamri: kol davar shehu mishshum shevut gazru alav ben hashshemashot. veha amrat resha rabbi! resha rabbi vesefa rabbanan?!
Amar leh: kevar rame leh rame bar chama lerav chisda, veshanni leh: resha rabbi, vesefa rabbanan.
Ravina amar: kullah rabbi hi, vesefa gezera shemma yiktom.
Hahu pulemusa daata linhardea. amar lehu rav nachman: puku avidu kevushe kavshe beagma, ulemachar nezil venittev illavayhu.
Etiveh rame bar chama lerav nachman, veamri la rav ukeva bar abba lerav nachman: talush venautz in, lo talush velo nautz la.

Amar leh: hatam beuzeradin. umena temra deshane lan ben uzeradin lesheen uzeradin — detanya: hakkanin vehaatadin vehahiggin — min ilan hen, veenan kilayim bakkerem. vetanya iddach: hakkanim vehakkidan vehaurebanin — min yarak hen, vehen kilayim bakkerem. kashya ahadade!
Ella shema minna: kan beuzeradin, kan besheen uzeradin. shema minna.
Vekidda min yarak hu?! vehatnan: en markivin pegam al gabbe kidda levana, mippene shehu yarak beilan! amar rav pappa: kidda lechud, vekidda levana lechud.
Mishna netano bemigdal veavad hammafteach — hare ze eruv. rabbi eliezer omer: im eno yodea shehammafteach bimkomo — eno eruv.
Gemara veammay? hu bemakom echad veeruvo bemakom acher hu!

Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: hacha bemigdal shel levenim askinan verabbi meir hi, deamar: pochet lechattechilla venotel. ditnan: bayit shemmilleahu perot, satum venifchat — notel mimmekom happechat, rabbi meir omer: pochet venotel lechattechilla.
Vehaamar rav nachman bar adda amar shemuel: beavvera delivne. hacha name baavera delivne.
Veha amar rabbi zera: beyom tov amru, aval lo beshabbat! hacha name beyom tov.
I hachi, hayeynu dekatane ala, rabbi eliezer omer: im bair avad — eruvo eruv, veim bassade avad — en eruvo eruv. vei beyom tov, ma li ir ma li sade?

a: Chassore michassera vehachi katane: netano bemigdal, venaal befanav veavad hammafteach — hare ze eruv. bamme devarim amurim? beyom tov, aval beshabbat — en eruvo eruv. nimtza hammafteach, ben bair ben bassade — en eruvo eruv. rabbi eliezer omer: bair — eruvo eruv, bassade — en eruvo eruv.
Bair — eruvo eruv, kerabbi shimon deamar: echad gaggot veechad chatzerot veechad karpefot — reshut achat hen lechelim sheshshavtu betochan. bassade en eruvo eruv — kerabbanan.
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: hacha bemigdal shel etz askinan, demar savar: keli hu, veen binyan bechelim veen setira bechelim. umar savar: ohel hu.
Uviflugeta dehane tannae, ditnan: hikkish al gabbe shidda teva umigdal — temein. rabbi nechemya verabbi shimon metaharin.
May lav, beha kamippalgi: mar savar — keli hu, umar savar — ohel hu.
Amar abbaye: vetisbera? vehatanya: ohel venissat — tame, keli veeno nissat — tahor. vekatane sefa: veim hayu nissotin — temeim, ze hakkelal: nissat mechamat kocho — tame, mechamat reada — tahor!
Ella amar abbaye: dechulle alma hesset mechamat kocho — tame, mechamat reada — tahor. vehacha birada mechamat kocho askinan, uveha ka mippalgi: demar savar — have hesset, umar savar — la have hesset.
Umatnitin bemay mokminan la? abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: bemanul uketir bemitna askinan, uvae sakkina lemifsekeh.
Tanna kamma savar la kerabbi yose, deamar: kol hakkelim nittalin beshabbat, chutz mimmassar haggadol veyated shel macharesha.
Verabbi eliezer savar la kerabbi nechemya, deamar: afillu tallit afillu tarvod — en nittalin ella letzorech tashmishan.
Mishna nitgalgel chutz lattechum, nafal alav gal o nisraf, teruma venitmet, mibbeod yom — eno eruv. mishshechashecha — hare ze eruv.
Im safek, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim: hare ze chammar gammal.
Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: sefek eruv kasher. amar rabbi yose: avtulemos heid mishshum chamishsha zekenim al sefek eruv shekkasher.
Gemara nitgalgel chutz lattechum. amar rava: lo shanu ella shennitgalgel chutz learba ammot, aval letoch arba ammot — hannoten eruvo yesh lo arba ammot.
Nafal alav gal vechulei. ka salka datach dei bae matze shakel leh.
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi, dei kerabbi, haamar: kol davar shehu mishshum shevut — lo gazru alav ben hashshemashot.
Afillu tema kerabbi, la tzericha, devae mara vachatzina.
Utzerichi. dei tena "nitgalgel" — mishshum deleta gabbeh. aval nafal alav gal, deiteh gabbeh — ema leheve eruv.
Vei tena "nafal alav gal" — mishshum demikkasse. aval nitgalgel, zimnin deate zika umayyte leh — ema leheve eruv tzericha.
O nisraf, teruma venitmet. lema li? tena nisraf —
b: Lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose. tena teruma venitmet — lehodiacha kocho derabbi meir.

Vesavar rabbi meir sefeka lechumera? vehatnan: tame sheyyarad litbol, safek taval safek lo taval; vaafillu taval — safek taval bearbaim sea, safek lo taval bearbaim sea; vechen shene mikvoot — beachat yesh bah arbaim sea, uveachat en bah arbaim sea; vetaval beachat mehen, veeno yodea beeze mehen taval — sefeko tame.
Bamme devarim amurim — betumea chamura.

Aval betumea kalla, kegon sheachal ochalin temein veshata mashkin temein, vehabba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin, o shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, veyarad litbol; safek taval safek lo taval; vaafillu taval — safek taval bearbaim sea, safek lo taval bearbaim sea; vechen shene mikvoot — beachat yesh bah arbaim sea, veachat en bah arbaim sea; vetaval beachat mehen, veeno yodea beeze mehen taval — sefeko tahor.
Rabbi yose metamme.
Kasavar rabbi meir: techumin deorayyta ninhu.
Vesavar rabbi meir techumin deorayyta?! veha tenan: im en yachol lehavelio, bezo amar rabbi dostay bar yannay mishshum rabbi meir: shamati shemmekadderin beharim.
Vei salka datach techumin deorayyta — mi mekadderin? veha amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: en mekadderin lo beare miklat, velo beegla arufa — mippene shehen shel tora.
La kashya: ha dideh, ha derabbeh. dayka name, dekatane: "bezo amar rabbi dostay bar yannay mishshum rabbi meir: shamati shemmekadderin beharim". shema minna.
Uremi deorayyta addeorayyta lerabbi meir,
Ditnan: naga beechad ballayla, veeno yodea im chay im met, ulemachar hishkim umetzao met. rabbi meir metaher vachachamim metammein, shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: mishnatenu shehaya aleha sheretz kol ben hashshemashot. i hachi, beha lema rabbi yose sefek eruv kasher?!
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: hacha bishte kitte edim askinan, achat omeret: mibbeod yom nitmaa, veachat omeret: mishshechashecha.

a: Rava amar: hatam tere chezke lekulla, vehacha chada chazaka lekulla.
Kashya derabbi yose adderabbi yose!
Amar rav huna bar chinnana: shane tumea, hoil veyesh lah ikkar min hattora. shabbat name deorayyta hi? kasavar rabbi yose: techumin derabbanan.
Veibbaet ema: ha dideh, ha derabbeh. dayka name, dekatane: amar rabbi yose: avtulemos heid mishshum chamishsha zekenim shessefek eruv kasher — shema minna.
Rava amar, hatam hayeynu tama derabbi yose: haamed tame al chezkato, veema lo taval.
Adderabba haamed mikve al chezkato, veema lo chasar! bemikve shello nimdad.

Tanya: ketzad amar rabbi yose sefek eruv kasher? erav bitruma, safek mibbeod yom nitmet safek mishshechashecha nitmet; vechen beferot, safek mibbeod yom nittakkenu safek mishshechashecha nittakkenu — ze hu safek eruv kasher.
Aval erav bitruma, safek tehora safek temea; vechen beferot, safek nittakkenu safek lo nittakkenu — en ze sefek eruv kasher.
May shena teruma — deamar haamed teruma al chezkatah, veema tehora hi; perot name — haamed tevel al chezkato, veema lo nittakkenu!
La tema: safek mibbeod yom nittakkenu, ella ema: safek mibbeod yom nidmeu, safek mishshechashecha nidmeu.
Bea rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak merav huna: hayu lefanav shete chikkarot, achat temea veachat tehora, veamar: ayrvu li battehora bechol makom shehi, mahu?

Tibbee lerabbi meir, tibbee lerabbi yose. tibbee lerabbi meir: ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam — delekka tehora. hacha — ha ikka tehora. o dilma: afillu lerabbi yose, la kaamar ella hatam, deim ita dehi tehora — yada la. aval hacha, ha la yada la?
Amar leh: ben lerabbi yose ben lerabbi meir bainan seuda haruya mibbeod yom — velekka.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: kikkar zo hayyom chol ulemachar kodesh, veamar: ayrvu li baze, mahu? amar leh: eruvo eruv.
Hayyom kodesh ulemachar chol, veamar: ayrvu li baze, mahu? amar leh: en eruvo eruv. may shena?
Amar leh: lechi techul aleh kora demilcha: hayyom chol ulemachar kodesh — missefeka la nachata leh kedushsha. hayyom kodesh ulemachar chol — missefeka la paka leh kedusheteh minneh.
Tenan hatam: lagin tevul yom shemmilleo min hechavit shel maaser tevel, veamar: hare ze terumat maaser lichshettecheshach — devarav kayyaymin.
Veim amar: ayrvu li baze — lo amar kelum. amar rava zot omeret: sof hayyom kone eruv,
b: Dei salka datach techillat hayyom kone eruv, i amar ayrvu li baze, ammay lo amar kelum?
Amar rav pappa: afillu tema techillat hayyom kone eruv, bainan seuda haruya mibbeod yom, velekka.

Mishna matne adam al eruvo, veomer: im bau goyim min hammizrach — eruvi lammaarav. min hammaarav — eruvi lammizrach. im bau lechan ulechan — limkom sheertze elech. lo bau lo lechan velo lechan — hareni kivne iri.

Im ba chacham min hammizrach — eruvi lammizrach. min hammaarav — eruvi lammaarav. ba lechan ulechan — limkom sheertze elech. lo lechan velo lechan — hareni kivne iri. rabbi yehuda omer: im haya echad mehen rabbo — holech etzel rabbo, veim hayu shenehen rabbotav — limkom sheyyirtze yelech.
Gemara ki ata rabbi yitzchak tane ippecha kullah matnitin. kashya goyim aggoyim, kashya chacham achacham!
Goyim aggoyim la kashya: ha — befarhagbana, ha — bemare demata.
Chacham achacham la kashya: ha — bemotev pirke, ha — bemakre shema.
Rabbi yehuda omer im haya echad mehen vechulei. verabbanan — zimnin denicha leh bechavreh tefe merabbeh.

Amar rav: leta lematnitin middetane ayyo. detane ayyo: rabbi yehuda omer en adam matne al shene devarim keechad, ella: im (ken) ba chacham lammizrach — eruvo lammizrach, veim ba chacham lammaarav — eruvo lammaarav, aval lechan ulechan — la.
May shena lechan ulechan dela — deen berera, lammizrach lammaarav — name en berera.
Amar rabbi yochanan: uchevar ba chacham.
Adderabba, leta lidayyo mimmatnitin.
La salka datach, deha shaminan leh lerabbi yehuda delet leh berera. ditnan: hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim,

a: Omer: shene luggin sheani atid lehaferish hare hen teruma, asara maaser rishon, tisha maaser sheni, umechel veshote miyyad — divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin.
Ulla amar: leta leayyo mimmatnitin. veella ha dekatane: rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin —
Ulla zuze zuze katane: divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda, rabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin.

Vesavar rabbi yose en berera? vehatnan: rabbi yose omer: shete nashim shellakchu et kinnehen beeruv, o shennatnu kinnehen lakkohen — ezehu sheyyirtze kohen yakriv ola, uleeze sheyyirtze yakriv chattat!
Amar rabba: hatam — keshehitnu.
I hachi, may lememra? ka mashma lan kidrav chisda, deamar rav chisda: en hakkinnin mitparshot.
b: Ella i bilkichat bealim, i baasiyyayt kohen.
Veakkatti: savar rabbi yose en berera? vehatanya: am haaretz sheamar lechaver "kach li agudda achat shel yarak o geluseka achat" — eno tzarich leasser, divre rabbi yose.
Vachachamim omrim: tzarich leasser. efoch.
Ta shema, haomer: "maaser sheyyesh li beveti mechullal al sela shettaale beyadi min hakkis". rabbi yose omer: mechullal!
Efoch, ema: rabbi yose omer: lo chillel. umay chazet deafchat tarte mikkamme chada, efoch chada mikkamme tarte!

Ha vadday ippecha tanya, dekatane sefa: umode rabbi yose beomer "maaser sheyyesh li betoch beti yehe mechullal al sela chadasha shettaale beyadi min hakkis" — shechillel. middekaamar hacha shechillel, mikkelal dehatam — lo chillel.
Hay sela chadasha hechi dame? i deikka tarte telat, deyesh berera — hayeynu kammayyta? ella delekka ella chada — may "taale"?
Ayyeyde detane resha "taale", tena sefa name "taale".

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: man hay tanna daafillu bidrabbanan let leh berera? detanya: amar lachamishsha hareni mearev al eze mikkem sheertze, ratziti — yelech, lo ratziti — lo yelech. ratza mibbeod yom — eruvo eruv, mishshechashecha — en eruvo eruv.
Ishtik, vela amar leh vela midde. velema leh tanna deve ayyo hu! la shemia leh.

Rav yosef amar: tannae shaklat mealma? tannae hi! detanya: hareni mearev leshabbatot shel kol hashshana, ratziti — elech, lo ratziti — lo elech. ratza mibbeod yom — eruvo eruv. mishshechashecha, rabbi shimon omer: eruvo eruv, vachachamim omrim: en eruvo eruv.
Veha shaminan lerabbi shimon delet leh berera, kashya derabbi shimon adderabbi shimon! ella efoch.
May kashya? dilma ki let leh lerabbi shimon berera — bidorayyta, aval bidrabbanan — it leh!
Kasavar rav yosef: man deit leh berera, la shena bidorayyta, la shena bidrabbanan — it leh. uman delet leh berera, la shena bidorayyta vela shena bidrabbanan — let leh.
Rava amar: shane hatam, devaenan "reshit sheshsheyareha nikkarin".

Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, hayu lefanav shene rimmonim shel tevel, veamar: im yerdu geshamim hayyom yehe ze teruma al ze, veim lo yerdu geshamim hayyom yehe ze teruma al ze, hachi name ben yardu ben lo yardu deen bidvarav kelum?
Vechi tema hachi name, vehatnan: terumat hakkeri hazze umaserotav betocho, uterumat maaser ze betocho. rabbi shimon omer: kara hashshem!
Shane hatam — deikka sevivav.
Vei baet ema — kidkatane tama, amru lo lerabbi meir: i atta mode shemma yibbaka hannod, venimtza ze shote tevalim lemafrea! amar lahen: lichsheyyibbaka!
Ulemay dislek addatin meikkara devaenan reshit sheshsheyareha nikkarin, may kaamri leh?
Hachi kaamri leh: ledidan — bainan reshit sheshsheyareha nikkarin. ledidach —

a: I atta mode shemma yibbaka hannod, venimtza shote tevalim lemafrea? amar lahen: lichsheyyibbaka.

Mishna rabbi eliezer omer: yom tov hassamuch lashshabbat, ben millefaneha uven milleachareha — mearev adam shene eruvin, veomer: eruvi barishon lammizrach uvashsheni lammaarav; barishon lammaarav uvashsheni lammizrach; eruvi barishon, uvashsheni kivne iri; eruvi bashsheni, uverishon kivne iri.
Vachachamim omrim: o mearev leruach achat, o eno mearev kol ikkar. o mearev lishne yamim, o eno mearev kol ikkar.
Ketzad yaase? molicho barishon umachshich alav, venotlo, uva lo. bashsheni machshich alav veochlo uva lo, venimtza mistakker bahalichato, umistakker beeruvo.
Neechal barishon — eruvo larishon, veen eruvo lashsheni.
Amar (lahen) rabbi eliezer: modim attem li shehen shete kedushshot.
Gemara "leruach achat" may nihu? lishne yamim. "lishne yamim" may nihu? leruach achat. hayeynu kammayyta!

Hachi kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi eliezer: i atta mode sheen mearvin leyom echad chetzyo latztzafon vechetzyo laddarom? amar lahen: aval. keshem sheen mearvin leyom echad, chetzyo laddarom vechetzyo latztzafon — kach en mearvin lishne yamim, yom echad lammizrach veyom echad lammaarav.
Verabbi eliezer? hatam — kedushsha achat. hacha — shete kedushshot.
Amar lahen rabbi eliezer: i attem modim sheim erav beraglav beyom rishon — mearev beraglav beyom sheni? neechal eruvo beyom rishon — en yotze alav beyom sheni.
Amru lo: aval. ha laye shete kedushshot hen. verabbanan sappoke mesappeka lehu, vehacha lechumera vehacha lechumera.
Amru lo lerabbi eliezer: i atta mode sheen mearvin battechilla miyyom tov lashshabbat? amar lahen: aval. ha laye kedushsha achat hi!
Verabbi eliezer: hatam mishshum hachana.
Tanu rabbanan: erav beraglav beyom rishon — mearev beraglav beyom sheni. neechal eruvo beyom rishon — en yotze alav beyom sheni, divre rabbi.
Rabbi yehuda omer:
b: Hare ze chammar gammal.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omrim: erav beraglav barishon — en mearev beraglav bashsheni, neechal eruvo beyom rishon — yotze alav bashsheni.

Amar rav: halacha kearbaa zekenim hallalu, veallibba derabbi eliezer deamar shete kedushshot hen. veellu hen arbaa zekenim: rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yishmael berabbi yochanan ben beroka verabbi eliezer berabbi shimon verabbi yose bar yehuda setimtaa. veikka deamri: chad minnayyhu rabbi elazar, umappek rabbi yose bar yehuda setimtaa.
Veha rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yishmael bar rabbi yochanan ben beroka ippecha shaminan lehu! efoch.
I hachi, hayeynu rabbi? ema: vechen amar rabban shimon ben gamliel vechulei.
Velichshov name rabbi! rabbi tane la vela savar la.
Rabbanan name tanu la vela savri la? rav gemara gemir la.
Ki nach nafsheh derav huna, ayel rav chisda lemirma derav adderav. mi amar rav: halacha kearbaa zekenim, veallibba derabbi eliezer deamar shete kedushshot hen?
Veha ittemar: shabbat veyom tov, rav amar: nolda baze asura baze!
Amar rabba: hatam — mishshum hachana.
Detanya: "vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehechinu" — chol mechin leshabbat vechol mechin leyom tov, veen yom tov mechin leshabbat veen shabbat mechina leyom tov.
Amar leh abbaye, ella ha ditnan: ketzad hu ose — molicho barishon, umachshich alav, venotlo uva lo. bashsheni machshich alav, veochlo uva lo. ha ka mechin miyyom tov leshabbat!
Amar leh rabba: mi savrat sof hayyom kone eruv? techillat hayyom kona eruv, veshabbat mechina leatzmah.
Ella meatta — yearvu belagin?
Bainan seuda haruya mibbeod yom, velekka.
Ella ha ditnan, rabbi eliezer omer: yom tov hassamuch lashshabbat, ben millefaneha uven milleachareha, mearev adam shene eruvin. ha bainan seuda haruya mibbeod yom, velekka.
Mi savrat demannach leh besof alpayim amma lechan, uvesof alpayim amma lechan? la, demannach leh besof elef amma lechan, uvesof elef amma lechan.
Ella ha deamar rav yehuda: erav beraglav yom rishon — mearev beraglav yom sheni, erav befat beyom rishon — mearev befat beyom sheni, ha ka mechin miyyom tov lashshabbat!
Amar leh: mi savrat deazel veamar midde? deazel veshatek, veyatev.
Keman? kerabbi yochanan ben nuri, deamar: cheftze hefker konin shevita.
Afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yochanan ben nuri ella beyashen, dela matze amar. aval beneor, dei bae lememar matze amar — af al gav dela amar, keman deamar dame.
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanin leabbaye: i hava shemia leh lemar ha detanya: lo yehallech adam lesof sadehu leda ma hi tzericha; kayyotze bo,

a: Lo yetayyel adam al petach medina kede sheyyikkanes lammerchatz miyyad, hadar beh!
Vela hi, shemia leh vela hadar beh. hatam — mochcha milleta, hacha — lav mochcha milleta hi.
I tzureba merabbanan hu, amrinan: shemata meshachteh. vei am haaretz hu, amrinan: chamra irchas leh.
Gufa, amar rav yehuda: erav beraglav beyom rishon — mearev beraglav besheni. erav befat beyom rishon — mearev befat beyom sheni.
Erav befat barishon — mearev beraglav bashsheni. erav beraglav barishon — en mearev befat bashsheni, sheen mearvin battechilla befat.

Erav befat beyom rishon mearev befat beyom sheni, amar shemuel: uveotah happat. amar rav ashe: dayka name matnitin, dekatane: ketzad hu ose? molicho barishon, umachshich alav, venotlo uva lo. bashsheni, machshich alav, veochlo uva lo.
Verabbanan, dilma hatam — etza tova ka mashma lan.

Mishna rabbi yehuda omer: rosh hashshana shehaya yare shemma titabber, mearev adam shene eruvin, veomer: eruvi barishon lammizrach, uvashsheni lammaarav. barishon lammaarav, uvashsheni lammizrach. eruvi barishon, uvashsheni kivne iri. eruvi bashsheni, uverishon kivne iri. velo hodu lo chachamim.
Veod amar rabbi yehuda: matne adam al hakkalkalla beyom tov rishon, veochlah bashsheni.
Vechen betza shennolda barishon, teachel bashsheni. velo hodu lo chachamim.

Rabbi dosa ben harekinas omer: haover lifne hatteva beyom tov shel rosh hashshana, omer: "hachelitzenu Adonai elohenu et yom rosh hachodesh hazze, im hayyom im lemachar". ulemachar hu omer: "im hayyom im emesh". velo hodu lo chachamim.

Gemara man "lo hodu lo"? amar rav: rabbi yose hi, detanya: modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer berosh hashshana shehaya yare shemma titabber, mearev adam shene eruvin, veomer: eruvi barishon lammizrach, uvashsheni lammaarav. barishon lammaarav, uvashsheni lammizrach. eruvi barishon, uvashsheni kivne iri. eruvi bashsheni, uvarishon kivne iri. rabbi yose oser.
Amar lahen rabbi yose: i attem modim sheim bau edim min hammincha ulemala, shennohagin oto hayyom kodesh ulemachar kodesh?!
b: Verabbanan, hatam ki hechi dela lezalzole beh.
Veod amar rabbi yehuda vechulei.
Utzericha. dei ashmeinan rosh hashshana — beha kaamar rabbi yehuda, mishshum dela kaaved midde. aval kalkala, demechze kimtakken tivla — ema mode lehu lerabbanan.
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte — mishshum delekka lemigzar alayyhu. aval betza, deikka lemigzar bah mishshum perot hannoshrin umishshum mashkin shezzavu — ema mode lehu lerabbanan, tzericha.

Tanya, ketzad amar rabbi yehuda matne adam al hakkalkala beyom tov rishon veochlah bashsheni? hayu lefanav shete kalkallot shel tevel, omer: im hayyom chol ulemachar kodesh — tehe zo teruma al zo, veim hayyom kodesh ulemachar chol — en bidvaray kelum. vekore aleha shem, umannichah.

Ulemachar hu omer: im hayyom chol — tehe zo teruma al zo, veim hayyom kodesh — en bidvaray kelum. vekore aleha shem veochlah. rabbi yose oser. vechen haya rabbi yose oser bishne yamim tovim shel galiyyot.
Hahu bar tavya daata leve resh galuta deittetzid beyom tov rishon shel galiyyot, veishtechit beyom tov sheni.

Rav nachman verav chisda achalu, rav sheshet la achal. amar rav nachman: may eeved leh lerav sheshet dela achel bisra detavya? amar leh rav sheshet: vehechi echol detane isi, veamri la isi tane: vechen haya rabbi yose oser shene yamim tovim shel galiyyot!
Amar rava: umay kusheya? dilma hachi kaamar: vechen haya rabbi yose oser bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana baggola! i hachi "shel galiyyot" — "baggola" mibbee leh!
Amar rav assi: umay kusheya? dilma hachi kaamar: vechen haya rabbi yose ose issur shene yamim tovim shel galiyyot, kishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana lerabbanan desharu.

Ashkecheh rav sheshet lerabba bar shemuel, amar leh: tane mar midde bikdushshot? amar leh tenena: mode rabbi yose bishne yamim tovim shel galiyyot. amar leh: i mashkachat lehu, la tema lehu vela midde.
Amar rav ashe: ledidi amar li ammemar: hahu bar tavya lav ittetzude ittetzid,

a: Ella michutz lattechum ata. man daachal savar: habba bishvil yisrael ze — muttar leyisrael acher.
Uman dela achal savar: kol deate leve resh galuta — addata dechullehu rabbanan ate.
Veha ashkecheh rav sheshet lerabba bar shemuel vaamar leh?! lo hayu devarim meolam.
Hahu lifta deate lemachoza, nefak rava, chazya dichmisha, shera rava lemizban minneh. amar: ha vadday meetmol neekra.
May amrat, michutz lattechum atya? habba bishvil yisrael ze, muttar leechol leyisrael acher, vechol shekken hay deaddata degoyim ata.
Kevan dachaza deka mappeshi umayyti lehu — asar lehu.
Hanhu bene genana degazzu lehu asa beyom tov sheni, leureta shera lehu ravina leoroche beh lealtar. amar leh rava bar tachlifa leravina: lesar lehu mar mippene sheenan bene tora.
Matkef la rav shemaya: tama deenan bene tora, ha bene tora shere?! veha bainan bichde sheyyeasu! azalu shayylu lerava, amar lehu: bainan bichde sheyyeasu.
Rabbi dosa omer haover lifne hatteva kulei.
Amar rabba: ki havenan be rav huna, ibbaya lan: mahu lehazekir shel rosh chodesh berosh hashshana? kevan dachalukin bemusafin, amrinan? o dilma — zikkaron echad ole lechan ulechan?
Amar lan: tenetuha, rabbi dosa omer: haover lifne hatteva kulei — may lav lehazekir?
Lo, lehatenot.
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane bevarayyta: vechen haya rabbi dosa ose berashe chodashim shel kol hashshana kullah, velo hodu lo.
I amrat bishlama lehatenot — mishshum hachi lo hodu lo. ella i amrat lehazekir — ammay lo hodu lo?

Veella may — lehatenot? lema li leippeloge betarte? tzericha, dei ashmeinan rosh hashshana — hava amena: beha kaamri rabbanan dela — mishshum deate lezalzole beh, aval berashe chodashim shel kol hashshana kullah — ema modu leh lerabbi dosa.
Vei ittemar beha — beha kaamar rabbi dosa, aval behach — ema mode lehu lerabbanan. tzericha.
Metivi: rosh hashshana shechal lihyot beshabbat, bet shammay omrim: mitpallel eser, uvet hillel omrim: mitpallel tesha. veim ita, bet shammay achat esre mibbee leh?
b: Amar rabbi zera: shane rosh chodesh, mittoch shekkolel leshacharit vearvit, kolel name bemusafin.
Umi it lehu levet shammay kolel? vehatanya: rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat, bet shammay omrim: mitpallel shemone, uvet hillel omrim: mitpallel sheva. kashya.

Vecholel atzmo — tannae hi, detanya: shabbat shechal lihyot berosh chodesh o bechullo shel moed, arvit shacharit umincha mitpallel kedarko sheva, veomer meen hameora baavoda. rabbi eliezer omer: bahodaa, veim lo amar machazirin oto.
Uvemusafin matchil beshel shabbat, umesayyem beshel shabbat, veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omrim: kol makom shezzakuk lesheva — matchil beshel shabbat umesayyem beshel shabbat, veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza.
May hava ala? amar rav chisda: zikkaron echad ole lo lechan ulechan. vechen amar rabba: zikkaron echad ole lo lechan ulechan.

Veamar rabba: ki havena be rav huna, ibbaya lan: mahu lomar zeman berosh hashshana uveyom hakkippurim? kevan demizzeman lizman ate — amrinan, o dilma kevan delo ikkeru regalim la amrinan. la hava bideh.

Ki atay be rav yehuda, amar: ana akkara chadta name amena zeman. amri leh: reshut la ka mibbaya li, ki ka mibbaya li chova may? amar li: rav ushemuel deamri tarvavyyhu: en omer zeman ella beshalosh regalim.

Metivi: "ten chelek leshiva vegam lishmona", rabbi eliezer omer: "shiva" — ellu shiva yeme bereshit, "shemona" — ellu shemona yeme mila. rabbi yehoshua omer: "shiva" — ellu shiva yeme fesach, "shemona" — ellu shemona yeme hachag. ucheshehu omer "vegam" — lerabbot atzeret verosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim.
May lav lizman? lo, livracha.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach lizman — zeman kol shiva mi ikka? ha la kashya: dei la mevarech haiddana — mevarech limchar uleyom uchera.
Mikkol makom — bainan kos? lema mesayyay leh lerav nachman. deamar rav nachman: zeman omro afillu bashshuk. ha la kashya, deikkela leh kos.
Hatinach atzeret verosh hashshana, yom hakkippurim hechi aved? i mevarech aleh veshate leh — kevan deamar zeman, kabbeleh aleh vaasir leh.
Dehaamar leh rav yirmeya bar abba lerav: mi badlat? vaamar leh: in, badelna.
Livroch aleh velannecheh — hamevarech tzarich sheyyitom! litteveh leyanoka — let hilcheta kerav acha, dilma ate lemisrach.

May have ala? shadderu rabbanan lerav yemar sava kammeh derav chisda bemaale yoma deresh shatta, amaru leh: zil chazi hechi aved ovada, ta ema lan. ki chazyeh amar leh: dalyu lirtiva rafsa leh beducheteh. ayyto leh kasa dechamra, kaddesh vaamar zeman.
Vehilcheta: omer zeman berosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim. vehilcheta: zeman — omro afillu bashshuk.
Veamar rabba, ki havenan be rav huna ibbaya lan: bar be rav deyatev betaanita bemaale shabbeta, mahu leashlome? la hava bideh. atay lekammeh derav yehuda vela hava bideh.
Amar rava: nechzeyeh anan, detanya: tisha beav shechal lihyot beshabbat

a: Vechen erev tisha beav shechal lihyot beshabbat, ochel veshote kol tzarko, umaale al shulechano afillu kisudat shelomo bishato. chal lihyot tisha beav beerev shabbat — meviin lo kevetza veochel, kede shello yikkanes lashshabbat keshehu meunne.

Tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: paam achat hayinu yoshvin lifne rabbi akiva, vetisha beav shechal lihyot beerev shabbat haya. veheviu lo betza megulegelet, ugemaah belo melach. velo shehaya taev lah, ella lehareot lattalmidim halacha.

Verabbi yose omer: mitanne umashlim. amar lahen rabbi yose: i attem modim li betisha beav shechal lihyot beechad bashshabbat, shemmafsik mibbeod yom? amru lo: aval. amar lahem: ma li likkanes bah keshehu meunne, ma li latzet mimmenna keshehu meunne.
Amru lo: im amarta latzet mimmenna — shehare achal veshata kol hayyom kullo, tomar likkanes bah keshehu meunne, shello achal veshata kol hayyom kullo.

Veamar ulla: halacha kerabbi yose. umi avdinan kerabbi yose? ureminhi: en gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur berashe chodashim, bachanukka uvefurim. veim hitchilu — en mafsikin, divre rabban gamliel. amar rabbi meir: af al pi sheamar rabban gamliel en mafsikin, mode haya sheen mashlimin, vechen betisha beav shechal lihyot beerev shabbat.

Vetanya: leachar petirato shel rabban gamliel, nichnas rabbi yehoshua lehafer et devarav. amad rabbi yochanan ben nuri al raglav veamar: chaze ana devatar resha gufa azel. kol yamav shel rabban gamliel kavanu halacha kemoto, achshav atta mevakkesh levattel devarav?! yehoshua, en shomin lecha, shekkevar nikbea halacha kerabban gamliel, velo haya adam sheirer baddavar kelum.
Bedoro shel rabban gamliel avud kerabban gamliel, bedoro shel rabbi yose avud kerabbi yose.

Uvedoro shel rabban gamliel avud kerabban gamliel? vehatanya, amar rabbi elazar (ben) tzadok: ani (hayiti) mibbene senaav ben binyamin. paam achat chal tisha beav lihyot beshabbat, udechinuhu leachar hashshabbat, vehitanninu bo, velo hishlamnuhu, mippene sheyyom tov shellanu haya. tama deyom tov, ha erev yom tov — mashlimin!
Amar ravina: shane yom tov shel divrehem, mittoch shemmitannin bo shaot — mashlimin bo arviyyot. shabbat, hoil veen mitannin bah shaot — en mashlimin bah arviyyot.

Amar rav yosef: la shemia li ha shemata. amar leh abbaye: at amart nihalan, veaha amart nihalan: en gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur berashe chodashim vechulei, veamrinan ala, amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir sheamar mishshum rabban gamliel, aval chachamim omrim: mitanne umashlim.
May lav, akkullehu? la, achanukka ufurim.
Hachi name mistabbera,
b: Dei salka datach akkullehu — ha bae minneh rabba merav yehuda vela peshat leh!
Uletamaych, ha dedaresh mar zutera mishshemeh derav huna: halacha, mitanne umashlim. ha bea minneh rabba merav huna vela peshat leh?!
