Mishna mi shehotziuhu nochrim, o ruach raa — en lo ella arba ammot.
Hechziruhu — keillu lo yatza.
Holichuhu leir acheret, netanuhu bedir o besahar, rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya omrim: mehallech et kullah. rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva omrim: en lo ella arba ammot.
Maase shebbau mippelandarsin, vehifliga sefinatam bayyam. rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya halchu et kullah, rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva lo zazu mearba ammot, sheratzu lehachamir al atzman.
Paam achat lo nichnesu lannamal ad shechashecha, amru lo lerabban gamliel: ma anu lered?
Amar lahem: muttarim attem, shekkevar hayiti mistakkel vehayinu betoch hattechum ad shello chashecha.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: shelosha devarim maavirin et haadam al dato veal daat kono, ellu hen: nochrim, veruach raa, vedikduke aniyyut.
Lemay nafka minna? lemive rachame alayyhu.
Shelosha en roin pene gehinnam, ellu hen: dikduke aniyyut, vechole meayin, veharshut. veyesh omrim: af mi sheyyesh lo ishsha raa.
Veiddach? ishsha raa mitzva legarshah.
Veiddach? zimnin dichtubbatah merubba. i name, it leh banim minna, vela matze megaresh la.
Lemay nafka minna? lekabbole meahava.
Shelosha metin keshehen mesapperin, veellu hen: choli meayin, vechayya, vehidrokan.
Lemay nafka minna: lemashmoshe behu zevavdta.
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: yatza ledaat — en lo ella arba ammot. peshita, hasheta mi shehotziuhu nochrim en lo ella arba ammot, yatza ledaat mibbaya?!
Ella ema: chazar ledaat — en lo ella arba ammot.
Ha name tenena: hechziruhu nochrim keillu lo yatza. hechziruhu hu dichillu lo yatza, aval hotziuhu nochrim vechazar ledaat — en lo ella arba ammot!
Ella ema, yatza ledaat vehechziruhu nochrim — en lo ella arba ammot.
Ha name tenena: hotziuhu vehechziruhu keillu lo yatza. hotziuhu vehechziruhu — hu dichillu lo yatza, aval yatza ledaat — la!
Mahu detema, litzdadin katane: mi shehotziuhu nochrim vechazar ledaat — en lo ella arba ammot, aval yatza ledaat vehechziruhu nochrim — keillu lo yatza, ka mashma lan.
Beo minneh merabba: hutzerach linkavav mahu? amar lahem: gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora.
Amri nehardae: i pikkeach hu ayel litchuma, vechevan deal — al.
Amar rav pappa: perot sheyyatzu chutz lattechum vechazru, afillu bemezid — lo hifsidu et mekoman. may tama? anusin ninhu.
Etiveh rav yosef bar shemaya lerav pappa: rabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omrim: leolam asurin, ad sheyyachzeru limkoman shoggin. beshogeg in, bemezid la!
Tannae hi, detanya: perot sheyyatzu chutz lattechum, beshogeg — yeachelu, bemezid — lo yeachelu.

a: Rabbi nechemya omer: bimkoman — yeachelu, shello bimkoman — lo yeachelu.
May bimkoman? illema: bimkoman — bemezid, veha katane behedya, rabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omrim: leolam asurin ad sheyyachzeru limkoman shoggin. beshogeg — in, bemezid — la.
Ella lav: bimkoman — beshogeg, vechassore mechassera, vehachi katane: perot sheyyatzu chutz lattechum, beshogeg — yeachelu, bemezid — lo yeachelu.
Bamme devarim amurim — shello bimkoman, aval bimkoman — afillu bemezid yeachelu. vaata rabbi nechemya lememar: afillu bimkoman name, beshogeg — in, bemezid — la.

La, bemezid bimkoman — dechulle alma la peligi deasur, vehacha beshogeg shello bimkoman peligi: tanna kamma savar beshogeg shere shello bimkoman, verabbi nechemya savar afillu shogeg, bimkoman — in, shello bimkoman — la.

Veha middekatane sefa: rabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omrim: leolam asurin ad sheyyachzeru limkoman shoggin, shogeg — in, bemezid — la, mikkelal detanna kamma savar: bemezid name shere. shema minna.
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: haya mehallech veeno yodea techum shabbat, mehallech alpayim pesiot benoniyyot, vezo hi techum shabbat.
Veamar rav nachman amar shemuel: shavat bevika, vehikkifuha nochrim mechitza beshabbat — mehallech alpayim amma, umetaltel bechullah al yede zerika.
Verav huna amar: mehallech alpayim amma, umetaltel arba ammot. venittaltel bechulla al yede zerika?
Shemma yimmashech achar cheftzo.
Bealpayim mihat litaltel ki orcheh!
Mishshum dehave kimchitza shennifretza bimloah lemakom haasur lah.
Chiyyay bar rav amar: mehallech alpayim amma, umetaltel bealpayim amma. keman? dela kerav nachman vela kerav huna!
Ema: metaltel bearba. i hachi, hayeynu derav huna. ema: vechen amar rabbi chiyyay bar rav.
Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna: la tiflog aleh dishmuel, detanya kevoteh. detanya:
b: Haya moded uva, vechalta middato bachatzi hair — muttar letaltel bechol hair kullah, uvilvad shello yaavor et hattechum beraglav. may metaltel, lav al yede zerika?
Amar rav huna: la, al yede meshicha.
Amar rav huna: haya moded uva, vechalta middato bachatzi chatzer — en lo ella chatzi chatzer.
Peshita! ema: yesh lo chatzi chatzer.
Hay name peshita? mahu detema: lechush dilma ate letaltole bechulla, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav nachman, mode li huna: haya moded uva vechalta middato al sefat tikra — muttar letaltel bechol habbayit.
May tama — hoil vetikrat habbayit chovetet.

Amar rav huna bereh derav natan: ketannae. holichuhu leir acheret, unetanuhu bedir o besahar, rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya omrim: mehallech et kullah. verabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva omrim: en lo ella arba ammot.
May lav, rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya deamru: mehallech et kullah — dela gazri hilluch dir vesahar attu hilluch bevika;
Umiddehilluch attu hilluch la gazri, tiltul attu hilluch la gazri.
Verabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva deomrim: en lo ella arba ammot, degazri hilluch dir vesahar attu hilluch devikah; umiddehilluch attu hilluch gazri, tiltul attu hilluch name gazri.
Mimmay? dilma ki la gazri rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya hilluch sahar vedir attu hilluch bika, hane mille hatam dishne mekomot hen.
Aval tiltul attu hilluch demakom echad hu, hachi name degazri, gezera shemma yimmashech acher cheftzo.
Verabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva name, mimmay demishshum degazri hu? dilma mishshum deka savri ki amrinan kol habbayit kullo kearba ammot dame, hane mille hecha deshavat baavir mechitztzot mibbeod yom.
Aval hecha delo shavat baavir mechitztzot mibbeod yom — la.
Amar rav: hilcheta kerabban gamliel bedir vesahar usefina. ushemuel amar: hilcheta kerabban gamliel, bisfina, aval bedir vesahar — la.
Dechulle alma mihat halacha kerabban gamliel bisfina, may tama?
Amar rabba: hoil veshavat baavir mechitztzot mibbeod yom.
Rabbi zera amar: hoil usefina notalto mittechillat arba umannachto besof arba.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu shennifchatu dofne sefina. i name: bekofetz missefina lisfina.
